reviewer: Kimi Code recovery review subagent actually viewed the exact source, complete parent RGB raw, complete derived RGBA raw, final white/cyan/source-alpha/return-alpha sheet, native-resolution derived detail regions, and unchanged mod_nailong/assets/reference/naiwa.png; read the prior RGB review, repair receipt and final evidence, then independently verified all hashes, RGB pixel equality, bilinear resized-source-alpha equality, corners and metadata using read-only Python. entries.positive_observation: The complete derived RGBA visibly preserves the approved parent art: a compact round yellow mascot with green-ringed solid black eyes, one restrained closed mouth and no human nose, ears or skin. The dark olive peaked cap retains its shiny visor, gold braid and oakleaf detailing, separate upper eagle and lower wreath/cockade. Short gray temple/sideburn hair and both dark brown eyebrows remain, with no glasses, moustache or beard. The nearly frontal direct-gaze stern pose, crop and under-cap shadow are unchanged. Two red gold-embroidered collar patches, two gold shoulder boards and one small gold throat button remain without duplication. The rounded chin meets a short broad fitted collar without pinching, floating cloth, clipping or a cream bib. The pale warm greige mottled backplate remains complete through the original rectangle, with no frame, note, halo or replacement backdrop.
entries.alpha_decision: The existing derived repair is accepted, not represented as a native transparent return. Read-only recomputation confirmed that the parent RGB pixels and derived RGB channels are identical, and that the source alpha resized with BILINEAR exactly equals the derived alpha; resized alpha raw-byte SHA-256 is 11e122a90e29c4446b6c237e34e49cbf168d719980366098d97c5453f58620c1. Source, resized and output corner alpha arrays are all [255,255,255,255]. Source and returned alpha extrema are [255,255], and all 4205568 derived pixels have alpha 255. Actual full white/cyan/alpha viewing shows a complete opaque backplate and solid clothing with no holes, matte, halo or backing loss; cyan strips are sheet letterboxing. No additional repair was performed.
entries.visible_limitations: At 156x210, the finest cap and collar embroidery, small cockade interior and shoulder-board weave are not fully readable. Their visible shapes, counts and placement were checked without claiming microscopic heraldic detail; these genuine source-resolution limits are not rejection grounds.
